problem_type: Real MCP client test process isolation
symptom: A Codex-launched Nomi process received only NOMI_MCP_STDIO and wrote to the user's real profile instead of the temporary test directories.
direct_cause: buildCodexOverrides defaulted to a one-key env object while main kept the four isolation paths only in the parent process environment.
class_root: The client configuration boundary did not require or validate the complete isolated Nomi environment before serializing it into the child client's MCP server configuration.
affected_population: Codex real-client runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Any future caller that omits one of the Nomi isolation directories
internal_only_reason: The invariant is repository-owned: this harness must serialize the same four temporary directories already required by Nomi's stdio boundary.
invariants: Every Codex MCP env contains NOMI_MCP_STDIO=1 and all four isolated directory variables.
The settings directory is a child of the system temp directory and the other three directories are its fixed children.
Real profile verification reads metadata only and never file contents.

door_reduction.why_not: The door map reports existing application readers, but this test-harness fix cannot consolidate those unrelated production readers; all client callers converge at buildCodexOverrides instead.

generality_proof: The only serialized Codex MCP environment is built by buildCodexOverrides; requiring the complete directory tuple there makes omitted, host-profile, and cross-platform callers fail before a client can start.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate and serialize the complete temporary Nomi environment for the child client.
Record metadata-only fingerprints for configured files and the real Nomi profile.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The Codex branch now passes the validated five-key isolation env into buildCodexOverrides.
The Claude branch already serializes the same four directories and NOMI_MCP_STDIO in its strict temporary config.

recurrence.reason: Any new real-client caller or omitted env key could reconnect Nomi to the host profile unless the shared serializer rejects it.
same_class_scan: Reviewed both codex and claude branches in tests/system/mcp-real-client.mjs

prevention.invariant: Only a complete tuple rooted below the system temp directory may be serialized to Codex.
prevention.failure_mode: Throw before spawning Codex when any key is missing, NOMI_MCP_STDIO is wrong, or a path escapes the temporary root.
prevention.strategy: Make the env argument mandatory and validate its fixed directory topology at the single serializer used by the real Codex run.

removed_paths: buildCodexOverrides default env containing only NOMI_MCP_STDIO
legacy_paths.rationale: The unsafe default is deleted; every caller must now provide and pass the complete isolation tuple.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure was caused by the harness-owned env serialization boundary, not a third-party runtime.

migration: No persisted data or user configuration changes; the next test invocation fails closed until its caller supplies the required temporary directories.
residual_risks: A live real-client run still depends on local Codex authentication and installed Electron; it is separately reported by the command result.
